origin.check: a dict keyed off rows then probed by a second query is a JOIN
a guard-continue over query rows is a withheld WHERE
sorted() over row-derived rows is a withheld ORDER BY
per-key accumulation is GROUP BY, not a join
a set() built purely to dedupe rows is a withheld DISTINCT
a set difference between two store-reading helpers is a set-op
identical algebra over a non-store argument is NOT reported
